summary: Quiet suburban kerb where cars park, but homes sit 15-17 m away.
reasons: Homes 13-17 m away on same side

best_section.where: Murray Street west kerb, north of the bend, about 60 m up from the corner

drivers.seclusion: Houses on both sides within about 15-20 m; no bush or open land beside the section.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; little through traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Parked cars line both kerbs, so a van blends in a little.

flags: About 3% grade, slightly over the flat limit
sun_shade: Mostly open; a large tree canopy to the west shades the north end in the afternoon.
